item.title: When the Motif Returns, Does Its Meaning Return Too? Narrative Arcs Tested with LangGraph
item.description: The Beatles, Metallica, and Maluma featuring Farina: distinguish a semantic echo, a position that persists, and an idea contested by another voice, through close readings, embeddings, and an inspectable RAG experiment.

item.title: The Evolution of Songs About Fear: A Reading Through Embeddings
item.description: Forty years of songs that talk about fear, read by a language model and measured with embeddings: the threat moved from the street into one's own mind, fear shifted to first-person confession, and songs learned to work through it.

item.title: What Should an Agent Remember? Album Narratives with LangGraph and MLflow
item.description: An empirical study of bounded memory, distant lyrical evidence, and token use across four albums.
